sources.label: Bala Isah Garba and Company August 2026 cNGN examination, Tables 1-7

reserveReview.rationale: Full independent report examined as of August 31, 2026 at 21:45 WAT. Table 2's four reported rounded shares describe the whole NGN3,550,845,048.39 reserve book; Table 1 reconciles NGN3,329,961,223.91 circulating liabilities. Table 4 identifies CDS MMF and FAAM MMF. Tables 5-7 identify Nigerian Treasury bills, financial-institution fixed-term placements and bank deposits. Bank counterparties, fund-share liquidity and fixed-term maxima are not inferred. The accountant signature is undated and management's signature stamp has no visible date; report-publication provenance remains unresolved. These measured rows cannot enter named-attestor scoring until that mandatory date is established; the generic 38-day route must not bypass the gate.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: August 31, 2026 reserve fair values: MMFs NGN1,906,693,594.74; Treasury bills NGN455,102,195.58; bank deposits NGN820,332,487.05; fixed-term investments NGN368,716,771.02. Reported rounded whole-book percentages 54/13/23/10 sum to 100.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All four whole-book categories are measured; admission is withheld pending independently established report publication/signing date. Depository counterparties, fund liquidity and fixed-term maximum terms remain unspecified.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Naira money-market-fund units are external reserve claims, not tracked stablecoin dependencies.
Nigerian sovereign Treasury bills are external reserve backing.
Naira bank deposits are external reserve claims.
Fixed-term naira placements with financial institutions are external reserve claims.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The 2026-07-31 re-opened issuer transparency, terms, and ASC FAQ identify only licensed/partner commercial banks and reserve accounts; they do not name active banks, disclose allocation shares, establish segregation or bankruptcy remoteness, state anti-rehypothecation terms, or document failure/replacement/successor-custody mechanics.
